title: The graph of a C^1 function has n-dimensional density one at each point
statement: Let n >= 1, R real, u : R^n -> R^l C^1 on the open ball of radius R about 0, and x in that open ball. Then H^n(graph of u over the open ball cap closed ball B_r((x, u(x)))) / (omega_n r^n) -> 1 as r decreases to 0, where H^n = muHE[n] and omega_n = unitBallVolume n.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (R : ℝ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) R, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ closedBall (graphPoint x (u x)) r) / ENNReal.ofReal (unitBallVolume n * r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
